notes: MUSIC: a turning record with a progress ring, title / artist / album from the MP3's tag, 1:23 / 3:45, TRACKS list, shuffle and repeat (off / all / one), hold play to stop; the knob's volume runs along the rim and fades; TEST is gone
ARCADE: on GAME OVER only AGAIN and QUIT do anything; in DASH the birds fly low -- duck them with the knob, jump the rocks
NEW GAME: BACK is a disc that stays inside the glass, OPEN TABLE no longer covers it, the join code sits clear of its title
FIRST: the roll lands and stays -- BEGIN: <name> starts the game; tap a name to pick it instead; the die rolls again
The face: no more swipe-up to the wheel (it fired under monarch and attack drags) -- swipe down, or press the knob
Battle screen: BACK disc beside RESOLVE instead of the X under it
Commander damage badges carry the initial of whose commander, in their colour; tap the badge for the name
